groupings.title: Coming from another tool
groupings.description: Rebuild what you already have: mapped column by column, priced before it runs, kept as code.

groupings.title: Find the accounts and the people
groupings.description: Sourcing: who exists, who fits, and who sits on the buying committee.

groupings.title: Get the contact data
groupings.description: Resolve identity, enrich it, and make sure the address is deliverable before you send.

groupings.title: Watch for the moment to reach out
groupings.description: Buying signals: someone moved, someone raised, someone started hiring for the thing you sell.

groupings.title: Decide who is worth the time
groupings.description: Rank a list against your profile, then understand the one account before you walk into the call.

groupings.title: Context
groupings.description: Deployed pipelines that keep what you know current: your website and the market's news, every recorded call, and, once you have a CRM, what won and lost deals say.

groupings.title: Fundamentals
groupings.description: Deployed pipelines that build the base: the account universe from your ICP, a standing score on every account, and, for an early-stage company, the website itself.

groupings.title: Signals
groupings.description: Deployed pipelines that watch the market for the moment to reach out. Any combination stacks on the same account.

groupings.title: Engagement
groupings.description: Deployed pipelines that hold the conversation with the accounts worth it.

groupings.title: Operations
groupings.description: Deployed pipelines that run the team: the daily recap, the weekly plan, and one agent everyone can ask.

groupings.title: Connect your CRM
groupings.description: Deployed pipelines for when a CRM is already in place: keep its records filled and duplicate-free so the engine and the CRM agree.
